title: How to apply to an artist residency
seoTitle: How to apply for an artist residency: a step-by-step guide
description: What residency applications ask for, how panels choose, and a checklist for Yaddo, MacDowell and smaller residencies, from work samples to references.
summary: What residency applications ask for, how to pick samples and write the proposal, and the windows and fees for seven programs.
primaryKeyword: how to apply for an artist residency
answer: To apply to an artist residency, check who can apply and what it will cost you, then gather what the program asks for: usually work samples, a statement, a project proposal and a CV. Pick samples that back up the proposal, say why this program suits the work, and submit before the deadline in its time zone.
keyPoints: Check each cycle on the residency's own page; deadlines move from year to year.
Pick samples that support your proposal, and follow every file and length rule.
A free application and a funded stay are separate questions, so check both.
illustrationAlt: Illustration of work samples, a residency proposal and a deadline calendar.
